content: Yerusalaamen Diza Asaa

Deraa kaaleththizayti Yerusalaamen de7ida; qasseka hankko tammu keeththa asaappe issi keeththa asi geesh gidida Yerusalaame kataman daanaytas saama yeggi doorida; hankko attida asay gidikko dumma dumma katamata baas deeththaso ooththides;
Asaykka, «Yerusalaamen daana» giidi ba shenen dendettida asaa ubbaa anjjides.

Hara gutataninne katamatan de7iza Isra7eele asay, qeeseti, Lewe baggati, Xoossa Keeththa oosanchchatinne Solomoone aylleta zereththati ba haaroy dizason dizason de7ida; hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayti Yerusalaamen de7iza Yuhuda dere kaaleththiza asata.
Yuhuda zarkkefe yida kaaleththizayti Paareese zereththafe gididayti Malal7eele naa, Shafaaxiya naa, Amaariya naa, Zakaraasa naa, Ooziya naa, Attayiya,
Seelo zereththafe Zakaraasa naa, Yoyaaribe naa, Adaya naa, Ooziya naa, Koli-Hooze naa, Baaroke naa, Ma7isaya.
Yerusalaamen uttida Paareese zereththatappe erettida wolqqama asati 468.
Biniyaame zereththatappe, Yesha7iya naa, Itti7eele naa, Ma7isaya naa, Qolaaya naa, Paddaya naa, Yo7eede naa, Mashulaame naa, Saaluye,
Saalus mata dabboti, Gabbayanne Sallaye, Yerusalaamen de7iza Biniyaame zereththati issi bolla 928.
Zikire naa Iyu7eeley istta kaaleththizayssa gidishin Hasanu7e naa Yuhuday izappe garsara katama ayssiza nam7anththo daanna.
Qeeseta baggafe, Yoyaaribe naa, Yaddaya naa, Yaakine naa,
Xoossa Keeththa halaqa gidida Ahixuube naa, Marayoota naa, Saadooqe naa, Mashulaame naa, Kilqiyaasa naa Saraya,
Isttara issife Xoossa Keeththa ooso ooththida asay issi bolla 822; Malkiya naa, Pashkure naa, Zakaraasa naa, Amozaane naa, Palaliya naa, Yirohaame naa Adaya,
Ha zereththata giddofe 242 korapinneta. Imere naa, Mashilemite naa, Ahizaya naa, Azari7eele naa, Amashisa,
Ha zereththata giddofe erettida wottadarati 128; istta kaaleththizay Hagidoleme naa Zabdi7eele.
Lewe baggafe, Buune naa, Hashaabiya naa, Azirqaame naa, Hashube naa Shama7e,
Sabataynne Yozabaade geetettiza Ewe baggata kaaleththizayti Xoossa Keeththas kare baggara oosettiza ubbaa oosos alaafeta.
Zabde naa, Mikka naa Maataaniya, mazamure yexxizayta halaqa gidida Aasaafe naa, ba ishatappe nam7anththoza Baqibuqiya, Shaamu7e naa gidida Abida naa, Galaale naa, Edotaane naa.
Lewe zereththatappe 284 asati geeshsha katama Yerusalaamen de7ida.
Xoossa Keeththa gibbe naagiza zabeti, Aqube, Xalmoonenne isttara issife ooththiza zabeti 172.
Hankko Isra7eele asay, qeesetinne Lewe baggati wuri ba gaden gaden Yuhuda katama giddon de7ida.
Xoossa Keeththa oosanchchati Yerusalaames issi baggara diza Ofeele geetettiza dhoqqasohon deettes; Xihaynne Gishafa geetettizayti isttas halaqata.
Yerusalaamen Leweta bagga halaqa Mikka naa, Maataaniya naa, Hashaabiya naa, Baane naa, Uuzey Xoossa Keeththan mazamure yexxizayta halaqa gidida Aasaafe zereththa.
Istti gallas gallas Xoossa Keeththan yexettiza mazamure maaran maaran tara oykki yexxana mala kawoppe izas imettida azazoy dees.
Yuhuda zarkken Zaraahe zareppe Meshezabele naa Pattayay Paarise kawoteththa giddon diza Isra7eele deraa koshshiza yo7otas kawo indiraase.
Hara Qeeri Katamatan Diza Asaa
Yuhuda asaappe issoti issoti ba gade matan diza katamata Qiriyaate-Arba7eninne iza matan diza gutatan, Dibooninne iza heeran diza gutatan qasse Yiqibixe7eeleninne iza heeran diza gutatan uttida.
Haray qasse Iyaaso, Molaade, Beeti-Phaleexe,
Haxaare-Shu7aale geetettiza katamatan deettes; Bersaabeheninne izi heeran diza qeeri katamatikka isttas duussaso;
Xigilaage kataman harappeka Mekoonnaninne izi heeran diza gutatan,
En-Rimoonan, Xora7an, Yarmuuten,

Zaanohen, Adulaameninne he katamata matan diza gutata ubbason deettes; qasse Laakisheninne izi matan diza gadetan, Azeeqeninne izi matan diza gutati wuri isttas duussaso; hessaththoka Yuhuda dere asay duge baggara Bersaabeheppe biidi pude bagga Henoome shoobbafe ha simmiin dizason uttida.
Qasseka Biniyaame zereththati, Geeban, Makimaasen, Aayen, Beeteleninne izi heeran diza gutatan deettes;
Qasse Anatooten, Nooben, Anaaniyan,
Haxooren, Eraaman, Geetime,
Hadiden, Xebo7imen, Nabalaaxen,
Loodaninne, Oonnon hessaththoka «Kushe hiillanchchata shoobba» geetettizaso ubbay isttas duussaso.
Yuhuda dere garsan diza Lewe baggatappe baggayti Biniyaame derera issife uttida.
